title: WorldComposer: Generative High-Fidelity Simulation with Digital Cousins for Generalizable Robot Learning and Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2604.15805v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning robust robot policies in real-world environments requires diverse data augmentation, yet scaling real-world data collection is costly due to the need for acquiring physical assets and reconfiguring environments. Therefore, augmenting real-world scenes into simulation has become a practical augmentation for efficient learning and evaluation. We present WorldComposer, an automated generative Real2Sim2Real framework that maps real-world panoramas into high-fidelity, task-ready simulation environments and further synthesizes diverse Digital Cousins through scene and object variations. Combined with high-quality physics engines and realistic assets, WorldComposer supports interactive manipulation across rigid, articulated, and deformable objects. Additionally, we incorporate multi-room stitching to construct consistent large-scale environments for long-horizon tasks. Experiments demonstrate a strong sim-to-real correlation

translated_title: WorldComposer：基于数字近亲的生成式高保真仿真，用于可泛化的机器人学习与评估
translated_abstract: 在真实世界环境中学习鲁棒的机器人策略需要多样化的数据增强，然而由于需要获取物理资产和重新配置环境，扩展真实世界数据采集的成本高昂。因此，将真实世界场景增强到仿真中已成为一种实用的增强方式，可用于高效的学习与评估。我们提出了WorldComposer，这是一个自动化的生成式Real2Sim2Real框架，它能够将真实世界的全景图像映射为高保真、任务就绪的仿真环境，并通过场景和物体的变化进一步合成多样化的数字近亲。结合高质量的物理引擎和逼真的资产，WorldComposer支持对刚体、铰接体和可变形物体的交互式操作。此外，我们引入了多房间拼接技术，以构建一致的大规模环境，用于长时程任务。实验结果表明仿真与真实之间存在很强的相关性。
tldr: WorldComposer是一个自动化的生成式Real2Sim2Real框架，能将真实世界全景图像映射为高保真、任务就绪的仿真环境，并通过合成多样化的数字近亲场景变体与多房间拼接，支持可泛化的机器人策略学习、评估及长时程任务。
en_tdlr: WorldComposer is an automated generative Real2Sim2Real framework that maps real-world panoramas into high-fidelity, task-ready simulation environments and synthesizes diverse Digital Cousins to enable generalizable robot learning, evaluation, and long-horizon tasks.
